comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: ALL treasure maps should be repeatable. Higher ranked maps that needs 10+ skill rank tend be difficult, sometimes frustrating, to obtain however (I recalled this Treasure Map took me 10+ headache meds before I was able to finally get). Also check to make sure you dont have a copy of this map already stored in your bank vault, binder, quarters, etc, since you can only have one on you at a time. And make sure you dont have the Hide Treasure Maps oxford skill equipped either. But I think your just having really bad luck.
